dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef001
dependency_coverage.meaning: For a measure mu and a real-valued function X, this is exactly LocalDef002 mu X, an extended-nonnegative-real quantity.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the quantity evaluated on the constant function x maps to a and bounded above by ofReal (C * |a|). Its body introduces no extra condition beyond the definition in D002.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef002
dependency_coverage.meaning: For mu and X, it is the infimum in ENNReal of the set of scales t satisfying LocalDef003 mu X t.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The left side of the asserted inequality is therefore an infimum of admissible exponential-moment scales for the constant function, not a chosen scale and not an assertion that the infimum is attained.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef003
dependency_coverage.meaning: A scale t is admissible for (mu,X) precisely when X is measurable, t is neither 0 nor top, the function omega maps to exp((X omega)^2 / (t.toReal)^2) is mu-integrable, and its mu-integral is at most 2.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It fixes the admissible set whose infimum is bounded. In the target X is the constant function with value a, while admissibility still includes measurability, finite positive scale, integrability, and the integral threshold 2.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef004
dependency_coverage.meaning: It is a proposition certifying that the numeral expression 1 + 1 is at least two.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supports the numeral-two machinery used within the nested scale condition; it contributes no additional mathematical binder or hypothesis to the target proposition.

dependency_coverage.name: And
dependency_coverage.meaning: Logical conjunction of two propositions.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It requires the same witness C to satisfy both C >= 1 and the universal bound.

dependency_coverage.name: ENNReal
dependency_coverage.meaning: The extended nonnegative real numbers, represented as nonnegative reals with an added top element.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Both the infimum-defined left side and the ofReal right side are compared as extended nonnegative reals, so the left side may in principle be top.

dependency_coverage.name: ENNReal.instPartialOrder
dependency_coverage.meaning: The partial order on ENNReal inherited from the with-top order on nonnegative reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the order relation used in the main inequality between the infimum-defined quantity and ofReal (C * |a|).

dependency_coverage.name: ENNReal.ofReal
dependency_coverage.meaning: It maps a real r to ENNReal by first taking its nonnegative-real part and then embedding that value; negative inputs are truncated to zero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The right side is formally the nonnegative extended-real embedding of C * |a|. Since C >= 1 and |a| >= 0, this input is nonnegative, but the truncating map is part of the exact statement.

dependency_coverage.name: Exists

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It asserts that one real constant C exists before, and is therefore uniform over, every later choice of probability space, measure, and real a.

dependency_coverage.name: HMul.hMul

dependency_coverage.name: instHMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: It turns a homogeneous multiplication structure on a type into the corresponding heterogeneous-multiplication instance with the same input and output type.

binders: There exists a real number C.
For that same C, universally quantify over every type Omega equipped with a measurable-space structure.
Universally quantify over every measure mu on Omega for which an IsProbabilityMeasure mu instance is available.
Universally quantify over every real number a.
hypotheses: The universally quantified measure mu is assumed to be a probability measure through the displayed typeclass instance.
conclusions: The witness C is at least 1.
For every displayed probability-measure setting and every real a, the infimum of all admissible scales for the constant function omega maps to a is at most ENNReal.ofReal (C * |a|).
A scale t is admissible exactly when the constant function is measurable, t is neither 0 nor top, omega maps to exp(a^2 / (t.toReal)^2) is mu-integrable, and its mu-integral is at most 2.
mathematical_definitions: For any real-valued X on Omega, define A(mu,X) = {t in ENNReal : X is measurable, t != 0, t != top, exp(X(omega)^2 / (t.toReal)^2) is mu-integrable, and its mu-integral is <= 2}.
LocalDef001 mu X = LocalDef002 mu X = inf A(mu,X), where the infimum is the ENNReal sInf appearing in the dossier.
ENNReal.ofReal(r) is the ENNReal embedding of the nonnegative part of r.
translation.proposition_plain_english: There is a universal real constant C >= 1 such that, for every measurable space, every probability measure mu on it, and every real a, the infimum exponential-moment scale of the constant random variable X(omega) = a is no greater than the extended-nonnegative-real embedding of C|a|. Concretely, that scale is the infimum over finite nonzero extended-nonnegative t for which X is measurable, exp(X^2/(t.toReal)^2) is mu-integrable, and its integral is at most 2.

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: The proposition concerns only constant real-valued functions, although it quantifies over arbitrary measurable spaces and probability measures.
The existential quantifier for C precedes all space, measure, and scalar quantifiers, so one common C must work uniformly for every case.
The statement bounds an infimum and does not assert that any minimizing scale exists or that the infimum itself satisfies the admissibility predicate.
Admissible scales explicitly exclude 0 and top; the behavior of the infimum can nevertheless reach a boundary value such as 0 through arbitrarily small admissible scales.
When a = 0, the right side is 0, so the target specifically forces the infimum for the zero constant function to be <= 0.
ENNReal.ofReal truncates negative real inputs to 0. Here C >= 1 and |a| >= 0 make C|a| nonnegative, but that fact is not encoded by replacing ofReal with a plain coercion.

If no IsProbabilityMeasure instance exists for a particular measured space, the universally quantified implication over such an instance has no case to check; the proposition does not separately assert existence of probability measures.

The packet exposes sInf through a conditionally complete order interface but does not state its exceptional-value convention for an empty or otherwise non-admissible set of scales; no nonemptiness of the admissible set is an explicit hypothesis.
ambiguities: The dossier does not unfold the conditionally-complete sInf operation far enough to determine from the packet alone its exact value on an empty or inadequately bounded admissible set; the translation therefore retains the formal infimum without assuming attainment or nonemptiness.

The packet gives IsProbabilityMeasure only as an external-frontier proposition/typeclass and does not expose its constructors or defining fields, so its exact internal normalization equation is not reconstructed beyond the mathematical assertion that mu is a probability measure.
